scope: The customer app, not the separate restaurant tablet/admin platform.
Current customer source and the shared backend, compared with the approved published Privacy Notice.
Payments/payouts exist in the product but real customer payments are paused. Pausing payments does not erase stored transaction information or justify declaring no collection.
No credentials, personal review-account data, live form writes or submission certification are included. Reconcile final answers against the exact selected binary and live configuration.

tracking.basis: No implemented cross-app/site advertising matching, advertising identifier, advertising-network SDK, data-broker handoff or external-CRM matching was found. Restaurant campaigns use the customer's own Cal-Eats relationship and orders with that restaurant. This is a finding about actual reviewed flows, not a guarantee about every possible future independent use.
recheckIf: External customer-list matching or advertising attribution is introduced
A payment, geocoding or other integration changes to supply app data for cross-property advertising
A merchant integration starts combining external customer records for targeted advertising

dataTypes.evidence: Account and order customer name; restaurant fulfilment and support. No SMS or direct marketing purpose is inferred from the customer directory alone.
Sign-in, welcome/verification, account recovery and transactional order/support email. Promotional email is not inferred from service email.
Checkout contact number and restaurant call-customer function.
Saved delivery addresses and delivery order/contact records.
Retained postcode/area and service coverage determine nearby restaurant availability.

Optional foreground GPS latitude/longitude passes through Cal-Eats to Postcodes.io. The app does not intentionally persist raw coordinates, but provider retention is not established as purely real-time. Include conservatively instead of claiming a collection exemption.
dataTypes.qualification: Linked is the conservative label because the first-party request can carry the signed-in session and precise location can identify a person. No precise-location marketing purpose is implemented. Reassess if verified processing and logging evidence supports a narrower label.

dataTypes.evidence: Account ID joins orders, consent, messages and restaurant relationship/campaign segments.

Installation identifier, Expo/native notification token, session/device binding, and iPhone Live Activity tokens. Consented merchant-offer push uses those delivery tokens; service notifications do not require marketing consent.
Items, totals, discounts, vouchers, payment/order status, order counts/recency, redemption and restaurant reporting.

Cal-Eats retains the form of payment, amount/status and provider references. The native customer app does not collect PAN/CVC or restaurant bank details. External hosted card entry does not exempt the form of payment actually retained by Cal-Eats.

dataTypes.type: User Content / Emails or Text Messages
dataTypes.evidence: Private order, restaurant/customer and platform-support correspondence, sender/recipient and read/delivery records. Encryption is not end-to-end.
Support subjects, requested help, replies, safety reports and the specifically reported evidence.
Order/delivery instructions, optional free-form reasons and star-only store ratings.
Offer viewed/dismissed/redeemed state and notification/message read state. Apply advertising/personalisation purposes to actual campaign interactions, not every private-message body.

Merchant offer opened/viewed and redeemed state, plus campaign recipient/opened/redemption counts. These actual promotional exposure/response records are more specific than general Product Interaction; no advertising SDK is required for the category.
Retained request/error identifiers, method/status/error code and hosted HTTP operational metadata. No verified anonymisation basis, so linked conservatively.
Server request duration and service reliability measurements. This does not claim native CPU, frame-rate or energy telemetry.

notSelectedForReviewedCustomerApp.reason: Intentional allergy-note collection is disabled and new non-empty allergy data is rejected. No health/fitness product is implemented. Incidental free text remains user content; reassess if deliberate allergy collection is activated.
Customer app displays restaurant images but has no customer photo/library upload. Merchant uploads are owner-only flows on the separate business platform.

notSelectedForReviewedCustomerApp.type: Audio Data / Contacts / Browsing History / Sensitive Info
notSelectedForReviewedCustomerApp.reason: No corresponding customer collection feature found. Do not generalise this to independent app-store/browser activity.
No credit score, income, debt, consumer-bank-account or investment feature. Transaction records are described by Payment Info and Purchase History.

No developer-run native crash-report SDK or direct crash upload was identified. Do not invent collection from a generic diagnostics dependency or confuse Apple's own system services with an implemented app telemetry pipeline.

encryptedInTransit.basis: Production app API and the implemented service-provider requests use HTTPS. Native client rejects remote cleartext API origins. This is not an end-to-end-encryption or all-storage-encryption claim.

deletion.inApp: Account > Security & privacy > Delete your account
deletion.process: Password/identity-confirmed intake, internal staff review and actual personal-data erasure/login revocation; necessary financial/legal evidence retained as explained in the notice. Not merely account disabling.

dataTypes.sharing: Restaurant fulfilment is a specific user-initiated order; ordinary processors act on the service's behalf. Apply those exceptions only to their actual permitted scope.
Transactional email/hosting processing; no marketing-email use inferred.
Customer relationship and merchant offers require their specific user-action/consent assessment; no external-list matching found.

dataTypes.userChoice: Optional overall; required for delivery, not collection
dataTypes.sharing: User-initiated delivery fulfiller; not an advertising-address handoff.
User-initiated order contact to the supplying restaurant; no SMS advertising feature.

dataTypes.userChoice: Optional location entry/device permission; postcode/area can be retained
dataTypes.sharing: GPS lookup is expressly user-requested; manual/saved location used for coverage.

dataTypes.userChoice: Optional Use my location + foreground device permission
dataTypes.sharing: Postcodes.io receives coordinates through the server, without customer name/email/device ID. No verified processor-only, no-retention guarantee; conservative draft declares sharing for this third-party lookup.
dataTypes.qualification: The Cal-Eats code uses raw coordinates in memory for a real-time lookup; supplier query retention is not proven ephemeral. Do not claim ephemeral processing solely because Cal-Eats has no coordinate database column.

dataTypes.sharing: Order fulfilment and merchant's own Cal-Eats relationship/campaign records; same user-action/consent scope assessment.

dataTypes.userChoice: Required payment form/status when placing an order; external card entry separate
dataTypes.sharing: Draft covers the payment form/status/reference retained by Cal-Eats, not PAN/CVC collected independently by external Stripe Checkout under Stripe's terms.
User deliberately addresses a restaurant or platform support. Protected server messages are readable to authorised recipients; do not claim Google's end-to-end-encryption exception.

dataTypes.userChoice: Optional instructions, ratings and support/report content
dataTypes.sharing: Only intended restaurant/support recipients or specifically reported evidence; no public customer comments or customer photo upload.

dataTypes.userChoice: Some interactions required for orders/service reads; marketing optional
dataTypes.sharing: Offer/message/notification interaction state. Do not claim whole-type optional merely because marketing consent is optional.

Search terms are sent as q to Cal-Eats restaurant and conversation filtering endpoints. No advertising/search-list handoff was found; hosting processing remains within the ordinary service-provider scope.
dataTypes.qualification: No application database search-history retention or query logging was found. The application error logger explicitly omits URL/query/body. Retained hosting HTTP path metadata exists, but exclusion of querystrings is not verified for this deployment; non-ephemeral is a conservative form answer, not a finding that a separate search-history database exists. If actual hosting evidence establishes memory-only processing and no query retention, change ephemeral to true rather than omitting this transmitted type from Google's form.

dataTypes.sharing: Retained hosted error/request records; processor exception depends on the hosting processing scope.

dataTypes.type: App info and performance / Other app performance data

dataTypes.userChoice: Notification permission/token is optional; installation/session identifiers also support device-binding/revocation. Do not call the entire type optional without checking all paths.
dataTypes.sharing: Expo/FCM processes push installation/routing tokens, including opted-in merchant offers.

routineAppContentRecommendations.privacyPolicy: Use the immutable approved URL above.
routineAppContentRecommendations.appAccess: Some features require login; supply a dedicated pre-verified CUSTOMER account privately in Console and working location/restaurant instructions.
routineAppContentRecommendations.targetAudience: 18 and over, consistent with approved Terms; no child-directed design claim.

containsAds.basis: No ad network, paid/sponsored native ad product or house-app-ad placement was found. Current restaurant discounts/offers are marketplace commercial content; do not assume a missing ad SDK alone settles this, or infer this answer from Apple's different data-purpose categories.
containsAds.recheckIf: Sponsored/purchased restaurant placements or advertising slots are actually introduced.

recommendedSelections: Rewards, points, frequent flier miles, and other incentives
financialFeatures.basis: Admin-issued Cal-Eats vouchers and restaurant promotional incentives exist. Ordinary hosted card payment for physical food is not a consumer bank/digital-wallet/remittance service. No loans, BNPL, investments, crypto or money-transfer feature.
financialFeatures.qualification: Confirm the current form's exact incentives wording before saving; do not choose no financial features merely because live charging is paused.

routineAppContentRecommendations.contentRating: Answer private messaging and merchant-generated content truthfully. Star-only customer ratings have no public comments. No gambling, contests, mature editorial material or age-assurance implementation found; do not fabricate content to reach the desired audience age.

specificFinalChecks: Google Required/Optional is a whole-type answer. Primary ordering needs account/contact/transaction information; guest browsing does not change requirements for ordering. Apply Optional only where all users can decline that type, such as GPS and private chat.

For Google's sharing column, cloud service providers acting solely on Cal-Eats' behalf and clearly user-initiated fulfilment/messages may qualify for exceptions. Do not apply that label to independent analytics/advertising reuse. This draft explicitly discloses the location lookup conservatively.

No material implemented cross-property advertising flow was identified. Recheck any actual changed third-party settings/integrations; hypothetical future merchant misuse alone is not a finding that tracking is implemented.

Postcodes.io's public operator policy is not a specific promise about raw reverse-geocoding coordinate retention. A verified narrower guarantee can justify revisiting precise-location retention and sharing answers; present draft does not rely on that guarantee.
Merchant photo rights/content-rights declaration, review contact details, secure review credentials, pricing/territories and applicable agreements remain operator facts, not privacy code facts.
A working ordering/payment/restaurant journey is still required before public submission. Do not describe disabled checkout or unavailable restaurant service as completed production review access.
Do not mechanically copy Android21 permission-education claims into notes/screenshots for selected iOS16. Validate the exact Apple binary before its public review.
